hero.title: STARTSEITE
hero.institutional: Internationales Zentrum für Entwicklung und Transition
hero.tagline: Leistung entwickeln. Menschen stärken. Zukunft vorbereiten.
hero.intro: MHSV® entwickelt und koordiniert sportliche, menschliche, schulische, soziale und berufliche Entwicklungswege, damit jede begleitete Person ihr Potenzial entfalten und wichtige Übergänge erfolgreich gestalten kann.

about.title: ÜBER UNS
about.lead: MHSV® - Internationales Zentrum für Entwicklung und Transition ist die institutionelle Identität von MHSV Association, einem Schweizer Non-Profit-Verein mit Sitz in Genf.
paragraphs: Die Mission besteht darin, die ganzheitliche Entwicklung des Menschen durch Sport, Bildung, Ausbildung, persönliche Begleitung und die Vorbereitung persönlicher, sportlicher, schulischer und beruflicher Transitionen zu fördern.

Fussball ist das wichtigste Startprogramm. Die Mission umfasst jedoch alle Sportarten und vor allem den Menschen hinter der Leistung. MHSV® verspricht keinen automatischen Zugang zum Profisport, sondern entwickelt realistische, individuelle und koordinierte Wege.
about.leadNoLegalStatus: MHSV® - Internationales Zentrum für Entwicklung und Transition ist eine in Genf (Schweiz) ansässige Organisation.

vision.title: UNSERE VISION 2035
vision.lead: Bis 2035 strebt MHSV® an, eine internationale Referenz für Entwicklung und Transition durch Sport zu werden.
vision.note: Wachstum soll die Qualität der Begleitung, den Schutz der Begünstigten und die Nachhaltigkeit der Organisation stärken.

pathway.title: DER MHSV® WEG
pathway.note: Erfolg bedeutet nicht ausschliesslich einen Profivertrag. Er kann auch sportliche Entwicklung, bessere Gesundheit, gelungene Orientierung, neues Selbstvertrauen oder ein gesichertes berufliches Projekt bedeuten.

programmes.title: SPORTPROGRAMME IN DER PRAXIS
programmes.lead: Ein Weg, der auf dem Feld aufgebaut wird.
paragraphs: Für die erste Umsetzungsphase nimmt MHSV® Teilnehmende auf, die in passende Alters- und Leistungsgruppen eingeteilt werden. Athletinnen und Athleten aus verschiedenen Sportarten sowie Begünstigte unserer Bildungs-, Personalentwicklungs- und Berufsintegrationsprogramme.

Das Programm kann technische, taktische und körperliche Trainings, interne MHSV®-Spiele, periodische Evaluationen, Freundschaftsspiele gegen lokale, nationale oder Elite-Strukturen je nach Kalender sowie Aktivitäten in Vorbereitungsphasen, Wettbewerbspausen oder ausgewählten Sportferien und Entwicklungs-Camps umfassen.
Das Modell ist auf andere Sportarten übertragbar: Gruppenstrukturen für Teamsportarten und individuelle Begleitung rund um Training, Wettkampf und Ziele für Einzelsportarten.

founding.lead: Die beiden Gründungsprogramme des ersten Umsetzungsjahres und der Einführungstarif.

international.title: INTERNATIONAL & EVENTS
paragraphs: MHSV® beabsichtigt, schrittweise ein Programm mit bis zu zwei oder drei Referenzturnieren oder -veranstaltungen pro Jahr zu entwickeln, abhängig von Sportart und operativer Kapazität.

Diese Veranstaltungen sollen schrittweise MHSV®-Strukturen, lokale und nationale Vereine, Ausbildungszentren, Elite-Strukturen, Akademien und - nach formalisierter Vereinbarung - internationale professionelle Organisationen oder Teams zusammenbringen.
Camps, Hospitationen und Vermittlungen hängen vom Profil, von verfügbaren Vereinbarungen und der operativen Kapazität ab; eine professionelle Platzierung wird nicht garantiert.

ecosystem.title: EIN VON MHSV® KOORDINIERTES ÖKOSYSTEM
ecosystem.lead: Je nach Bedarf mobilisiert und koordiniert MHSV® spezialisierte Kompetenzen: Training, Athletik, mentale Vorbereitung, Physiotherapie, Ernährung, Videoanalyse, Gesundheit, Bildung und berufliche Transition.
ecosystem.note: Externe Partner arbeiten innerhalb eines strukturierten MHSV®-Weges, wobei jede Fachperson die Verantwortung ihres eigenen Fachgebiets behält.

fees.title: TARIFE & ZUGANG
fees.headline: MHSV® Komplettprogramm - alle Sportarten: CHF 15’000 / Jahr / begünstigte Person - Einführungstarif.
paragraphs: Die genauen eingeschlossenen Leistungen werden im Programmvertrag festgelegt. Gezielte Module werden separat offeriert. Camps, Reisen, Turniere, ausserordentliche Leistungen und gewisse Drittleistungen können besonderen Bedingungen oder Preisen unterliegen.
Empfohlener kompletter Zyklus: 3 Jahre. Vertragsdauer und Module werden an Profil und Bedarf angepasst.
fees.lead: Ein einheitlicher Einführungstarif, mit an jedes Profil angepassten Inhalten.

inclusion.title: PROJEKTE, INKLUSION & UMSETZUNG
paragraphs: MHSV® möchte schrittweise Bildungs-, Sozial- und Inklusionsprogramme durch Sport mit Schulen, Gemeinden, Institutionen und spezialisierten Organisationen entwickeln.
Diese Angebote ergänzen Familien und qualifizierte Fachpersonen und ersetzen weder Schule noch Gesundheitsfachpersonen oder Sozialdienste.

digital.roadmapLead: Roadmap: Bereich für Begünstigte, Zielverfolgung, Trainer-Feedback, Dokumente, Video, autorisierte Kommunikation und Fortschrittsindikatoren.
paragraphs: Künstliche Intelligenz kann Zusammenfassungen, Organisation, Mehrsprachigkeit und ausgewählte personalisierte Inhalte unterstützen. Sie darf wichtige Entscheidungen zu Aufnahme, Gesundheit, Selektion oder Zukunft einer Person nicht selbstständig treffen.
Zielarchitektur: Sicherheit, rollenbasierter Zugriff, Datenminimierung sowie Hosting/Speicherung in der Schweiz - mit dem gewählten Anbieter zu bestätigen.

founder.title: GRÜNDER
founder.name: Martial HAPPI
founder.bio: In Genf ansässiger Unternehmer, ehemaliger internationaler Fussballspieler auf Pre-Elite-Niveau, UEFA-C-Trainer und ehemaliger offizieller Amateur-Schiedsrichter. Er gründete MHSV®, um Sportentwicklung, Bildung, Gesundheit, berufliche Entwicklung, Inklusion und Transition zu verbinden.
founder.quote: Hinter jeder Leistung steht ein Mensch. Hinter jedem Menschen steckt Potenzial. Und dieses Potenzial verdient Begleitung.

dataProtection.title: Data Protection Notice
intro: This Data Protection Notice (the "Notice") describes how MHSV Association (the "Association") collects, uses, retains, discloses and protects the personal data of users of its website, its members and its services, including the sports training provided by the Association (the "Services").
The Association processes personal data in accordance with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (the "FADP") and, where applicable, the European General Data Protection Regulation (the "GDPR").
Capitalised terms that are not defined in this Notice have the meanings given to them in the Terms and Conditions of Use.

By clicking the "I have read, understood and accept the Data Protection Notice" button, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Notice and agree that your personal data may be processed in accordance with it.
You acknowledge that your personal data will be processed under the conditions described in this Notice and in accordance with applicable law.

Where the processing of certain personal data, including sensitive personal data, particularly health data, is based on your consent, your consent will be requested separately in accordance with applicable law.
If you do not accept the processing arrangements described in this Notice, please do not use our website or Services.

sections.heading: 2. Data controller
paragraphs: The data controller is:
MHSV Association
Mr Martial Happi
Chemin de Beau-Soleil 26, 1206 Geneva, Switzerland
If you have any questions about the processing of your personal data or wish to exercise your rights, you may contact us at: infos@mhsv.ch.

sections.heading: 3. What personal data do we collect?
paragraphs: Depending on the Services used, we may collect the following categories of personal data:
items: identification data, such as your surname, first name, email address, telephone number and postal address;
data relating to your professional activity, such as your company name, its business identification number (UID), VAT number or any other information required to identify you;

data relating to your sporting background and activities, including your discipline, club or organisation, level of participation, sporting history, results, performance, objectives, training programmes and progress data;

data relating to your physical condition and sporting performance, including the results of physical, physiological or functional tests, performance measurements and, where applicable, data from equipment, sensors or tracking tools used in connection with the programmes offered by the Association;

sensitive personal data relating to your health, where its processing is necessary or useful for the delivery of the relevant programmes and services, including information about your physical or mental health, medical history, injuries, treatments, limitations or contraindications to sporting activity, as well as the results of assessments or tests carried out as part of your support programme;
where applicable, data relating to your well-being, psychological or emotional state and psychosocial support, where this information is necessary to provide individualised support;

data relating to your academic, educational and professional background, including your training, qualifications, skills, professional experience and career plans, where required for your support, particularly in connection with a dual pathway, a transition to professional sport or a career change;
technical data, such as your IP address, connection logs and information relating to your browser, device or use of the Services.

paragraphs: When we process sensitive personal data, particularly health data, we implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure a level of protection suited to the nature and sensitivity of the data concerned. Such data is collected and processed only to the extent necessary for the intended purposes and in accordance with applicable data-protection legislation.
Please provide only the personal data necessary to use the Services and ensure that any data relating to a third party is lawfully disclosed to us.

sections.heading: 4. Why do we process your personal data?
paragraphs: We process your personal data only where necessary and for the following purposes:
items: where relevant and in accordance with applicable law, to facilitate introductions and cooperation with participants in the Association’s ecosystem, including coaches, trainers, mentors, experts, healthcare professionals, clubs, academies, federations, educational institutions and partners;
to manage relationships with members, beneficiaries, partners, donors, service providers and other persons or organisations connected with the Association;
to manage requests for information, registrations, communications and correspondence addressed to the Association;
to manage the Association’s administrative, accounting, financial and operational activities;
to ensure the proper operation, security and improvement of our Services, platforms and digital tools;
to comply with our legal and regulatory obligations, respond to requests from competent authorities and, where necessary, establish, exercise or defend legal claims;
subject to applicable legal requirements, to inform you about the Association’s activities, programmes, events, projects and news;
to provide, organise and manage the services, programmes, training courses, activities and events offered by the Association;
to manage your registration, participation and monitoring in connection with the training, support and development programmes offered by the Association;
to design, adapt and personalise training and support programmes according to your profile, needs, objectives and progress;
to provide individualised support across the different dimensions of your pathway, including sporting, educational, academic, professional, personal and social aspects;

to support athletes in their development, preparation for high-level sport, transition to professional sport, management of a dual sporting and academic or professional pathway, and career transition.

paragraphs: Depending on the circumstances, the processing of your personal data is based in particular on:
items: the performance of a contract or pre-contractual measures;
compliance with a legal or regulatory obligation;
our legitimate interests, including ensuring the security of our Services, preventing fraud and improving our services;
your consent, where required.

sections.heading: 5. Disclosure of your personal data
paragraphs: We never sell your personal data.
We may, however, disclose certain personal data where necessary:
items: to technical service providers acting on our behalf, including for hosting, maintenance, IT security or sending communications;
to judicial, administrative or regulatory authorities where required by law or necessary to protect our rights;
to our professional advisers or any other person where disclosure is necessary for the performance of the Services or compliance with our legal obligations.

paragraphs: Where personal data is disclosed to service providers acting on our behalf, we ensure that they provide appropriate safeguards for the protection of personal data.

sections.heading: 6. Data retention and transfers
paragraphs: We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes described in this Notice or to comply with our legal, regulatory or contractual obligations.

In particular, data is retained for the duration of your relationship with the Association. At the end of the applicable retention periods, personal data is deleted, anonymised or archived in accordance with applicable law.
Personal data is primarily hosted in Switzerland or the European Economic Area.

Where personal data is transferred to a country that is not recognised as providing an adequate level of protection, the Association implements appropriate safeguards under applicable law, including standard contractual clauses approved by the competent authorities or any other recognised mechanism.

sections.heading: 7. Data security
paragraphs: The Association implements appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against unauthorised access, loss, destruction, disclosure or accidental or unlawful alteration.
These measures take account of the state of the art, the nature of the data processed, the risks posed by the processing and the applicable legal requirements.
Although the Association endeavours to maintain a high level of security, no IT system or electronic transmission method can guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: 8. Your rights
paragraphs: In accordance with applicable law, you may request in particular:
items: access to your personal data;
correction of inaccurate or incomplete data;
deletion of your data, where the legal requirements are met;
restriction of certain processing activities;
withdrawal of your consent where the processing is based on consent;
to object to certain processing activities, within the limits provided by applicable law.

paragraphs: To exercise your rights, you may contact us at: infos@mhsv.ch.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent data-protection authority.

sections.heading: 9. Cookies
paragraphs: Our website and Services use cookies and similar technologies that are necessary for their proper operation, including to secure connections, maintain your session and remember certain preferences.
We do not use advertising cookies. If cookies requiring your consent are used in the future, we will inform you in accordance with applicable law.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to this Notice
paragraphs: The Association may amend this Notice at any time, including to reflect legal, regulatory or technical developments or changes to its Services.
The most recent version is published on our website and takes effect when it is posted online.
